title: Constant-factor hardness of directed feedback vertex set
exact_target: For every fixed $A\geq 1$, is finding a directed feedback vertex set within factor A NP-hard on explicitly given unweighted digraphs, with a positive threshold and a deterministic polynomial-time gap reduction?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
